recipes.name: Beetroot Latte
instructions: Combine the soy milk, beet, dates, and vanilla extract in a high-powered blender until smooth and creamy.

Pour this mixture straight into a saucepan over medium-high heat. If your blender isn't very powerful, or if you don't like small fibres to remain in your drink, strain the mixture through a sieve while pouring it into the saucepan.
Add the cinnamon stick and maple syrup. Let the mixture heat up, stirring throughout to prevent burning. Let simmer for about 3 minutes, then remove the cinnamon stick.
Pour into mugs and optionally add a shot of espresso. Stir, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium . † For us, 1 cooked beet weighed about 130g.
